Google MediaPipeTasks 1.2.2. Unmodified binaries, pinned by upstream SHA-256.
Source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/tree/5b6fea33b95a78ae3dc61f4ed96a2f7df85a672e

The local SwiftPM wrapper includes only the Common, Graphs and Vision binaries.
The wrapper source, privacy manifest and Apache-2.0 license come from the same
upstream version previously used by this project. It links Objective-C classes,
C++ and required Apple frameworks. config/MediaPipePose.xcconfig force-loads the
graph archive in the app target, matching the qualified Counter V2 research build.
Hosted tests resolve private graph registrations through their app host.

Counter V2 uses CPU PoseLandmarker image mode, up to two poses, and the pinned Full
model. It invokes the auxiliary provider selectively from native contact checks;
the retired per-frame ShoeContactRecovery implementation is not restored.
Heavy, Text, Audio, Retrieval and Decision SDK/model candidates are not bundled.

Run scripts/install-counter-pose-model.py before building. SwiftPM downloads and
verifies the three SDK archives automatically. CounterV2IntegrationTests exercises
real image inference, a blank exposure, reacquisition and provider warmup so an
otherwise successful link cannot conceal missing registration dependencies.
